rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 18 “Triads up the neck” · title

rows.source: Three-note chords on the top strings: major and minor, every inversion, and progressions that barely move.
rows.translation: Tretonersakkorder på de øverste strengene: dur og moll, alle omvendinger og akkordrekker med knapt noen bevegelse.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 “Triads up the neck” · unit summary
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A triad is the smallest full chord: a root, a third and a fifth. On strings 3, 2 and 1, triads ring clear and bright, and they work anywhere on the neck.
rows.translation: En treklang er den minste fullstendige akkorden: grunntone, ters og kvint. På streng 3, 2 og 1 klinger treklanger klart og lyst, og de virker overalt på halsen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which notes make a C major triad?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Root, third, fifth: from C, skip a letter to E, then skip another to G.
rows.translation: Grunntone, ters, kvint: fra C hopper du over én bokstav til E, så enda én til G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move the lowest note to the top and you get an inversion. With E at the bottom, C sits at frets 9, 8 and 8. With G at the bottom, it's the top of your open C.
rows.translation: Flytt nederste tone til toppen, så får du en omvending. Med E nederst ligger C på bånd 9, 8 og 8. Med G nederst er det toppen av åpen C.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every major triad on these strings uses one of three shapes, one per inversion. Learn them on G and D and you can find any major chord.
rows.translation: Hver durtreklang på disse strengene bruker ett av tre grep, ett per omvending. Lær dem på G og D, så kan du finne alle durakkorder.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G at frets 4, 3 and 3 has the same shape as…
rows.translation: G på bånd 4, 3 og 3 har samme form som…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Both put the third at the bottom: one fret up on string 3, the other two level. Same shape, five frets apart.
rows.translation: Begge har tersen nederst: ett bånd opp på streng 3, de to andre på samme bånd. Samme grep, fem bånd fra hverandre.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: D at frets 7, 7 and 5 has the root-position shape of your C at fret 5. Lower down, frets 2, 3 and 2 are the top of your open D.
rows.translation: D på bånd 7, 7 og 5 har grunnstillingsformen til C på bånd 5. Lenger ned er bånd 2, 3 og 2 toppen av åpen D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A minor triad is a major triad with its third one fret lower. On these strings, A minor at frets 2, 1 and 0 is the top of your open A minor.
rows.translation: En molltreklang er en durtreklang med tersen ett bånd lavere. På disse strengene er A-moll på bånd 2, 1 og 0 toppen av åpen A-moll.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Barre fret 5 across strings 3, 2 and 1 and you have A minor with C at the bottom. One finger, three notes.
rows.translation: Hold barré på bånd 5 over streng 3, 2 og 1, så har du A-moll med C nederst. Én finger, tre toner.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: E minor at frets 4, 5 and 3 puts B at the bottom. It sits right beside A minor at fret 5, so the change is tiny.
rows.translation: E-moll på bånd 4, 5 og 3 har B nederst. Den ligger rett ved A-moll på bånd 5, så skiftet er lite.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pick the inversion closest to your hand and a progression barely moves. G, E minor, C and D all live between frets 2 and 5.
rows.translation: Velg omvendingen nærmest hånden, så beveger akkordrekken seg knapt. G, E-moll, C og D ligger alle mellom bånd 2 og 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From G at frets 4, 3, 3 to E minor at 4, 5, 3, which notes stay?
rows.translation: Fra G på bånd 4, 3, 3 til E-moll på 4, 5, 3: hvilke toner blir?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B on string 3 and G on string 1 stay put. Only string 2 moves, from D up to E.
rows.translation: B på streng 3 og G på streng 1 blir på plass. Bare streng 2 flyttes, fra D opp til E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same four chords sit higher too: G at frets 7, 8 and 7, E minor at 9, 8 and 7, C at 9, 8 and 8, and D at 7, 7 and 5.
rows.translation: De samme fire akkordene ligger også høyere: G på bånd 7, 8 og 7, E-moll på 9, 8 og 7, C på 9, 8 og 8, og D på 7, 7 og 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play a triad's notes one at a time and you have an arpeggio. Through a progression, the notes make a melody of their own.
rows.translation: Spill tonene i en treklang én om gangen, så har du et arpeggio. Gjennom en akkordrekke danner tonene sin egen melodi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A chord played one note at a time
rows.translation: En akkord spilt én tone om gangen
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: En akkord slått an to ganger

rows.source: The top notes here run G, G, G, F sharp: almost still while the chords change under them. A note that two chords share is a common tone, and it's why triads sound so smooth.
rows.translation: Topptonene her går G, G, G, F kryss: nesten stille mens akkordene skifter under. En tone som to akkorder deler, er en fellestone, og det er derfor treklanger låter så smidig.

Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Roller Rink is a Timbre Original: retro dance pop on G, E minor, C and D, your four triads between frets 2 and 5. Small shapes on the top strings sound bright and tight, like a second guitar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Roller Rink er en Timbre-original: retropop for dans på G, E-moll, C og D, de fire treklangene dine mellom bånd 2 og 5. Små grep på de øverste strengene låter lyst og stramt, som en ekstra gitar. Hele sangen finnes i Sanger, under Originaler.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Roller Rink's loop is the one, six, four and five of G. Which chord is the six?
rows.translation: Sløyfen i Roller Rink er første, sjette, fjerde og femte trinn i G. Hvilken akkord er sjette?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up G major: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. The chord on 6 is minor: E minor.
rows.translation: Tell opp G-dur: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. Akkorden på 6 er moll: E-moll.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Treklanger fra øverste streng og ned
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 4 (along) · title

Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: major and minor triads, their inversions, G, E minor, C and D in two places, and the arpeggios. Keep every move small.
rows.translation: Ikke noe nytt: dur- og molltreklanger, omvendingene deres, G, E-moll, C og D på to steder, og arpeggioene. Hold hver bevegelse liten.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: En molltreklang er en durtreklang med…

rows.source: Major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, the ii–V–I, and swing comping.
rows.translation: Dur med stor septim, mollseptim og dominantseptim, åpne og med barré, ii–V–I og swingkomp.

Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A major seventh chord adds the note one fret below the root's octave. It turns a plain major chord soft and dreamy. Open Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted.
rows.translation: En durakkord med stor septim legger til tonen ett bånd under grunntonens oktav. Den gjør en vanlig durakkord myk og drømmende. Åpen Cmaj7 er C med finger 1 løftet.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Cmaj7 is C plus which note?
rows.translation: Cmaj7 er C pluss hvilken tone?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The major seventh sits one fret below the root's octave: B, just under C.
rows.translation: Den store septimen ligger ett bånd under grunntonens oktav: B, rett under C.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play the mini F, but let finger 1 press string 2 only. Open string 1, E, is the major seventh of F.
rows.translation: Spill mini-F, men la finger 1 bare trykke streng 2. Åpen streng 1, E, er den store septimen i F.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A minor seventh chord adds the note two frets below the root's octave. It sounds mellow, between dark and bright. Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted.
rows.translation: En mollseptimakkord legger til tonen to bånd under grunntonens oktav. Den låter mykt, mellom mørkt og lyst. Am7 er A-moll med finger 3 løftet.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Dm7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Em7: just finger 2 on string 5, fret 2.
rows.translation: Dm7: finger 2 på streng 3, bånd 2, og finger 1 flatt over streng 2 og 1 på bånd 1. Em7: bare finger 2 på streng 5, bånd 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The minor seventh sits two frets below the root's octave: G, two frets under A.

rows.source: Jazz's favorite move: the chord on the second note of the key, then the fifth, then home. In C that's Dm7, G7 and Cmaj7.
rows.translation: Jazzens favoritt: akkorden på andre tone i tonearten, så den femte, så hjem. I C er det Dm7, G7 og Cmaj7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Play the E7 shape as a barre at fret 3: finger 1 across all six strings, finger 3 on string 5 and finger 2 on string 3. Its root is on string 6.
rows.translation: Spill E7-grepet som barré på bånd 3: finger 1 over alle seks strenger, finger 3 på streng 5 og finger 2 på streng 3. Grunntonen er på streng 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Hvilken akkord er ii i C?

rows.source: Count up from C: C is one, D is two. The seventh chord built on D is D minor seven.
rows.translation: Tell opp fra C: C er en, D er to. Septimakkorden bygd på D er D-mollseptim.

rows.source: Jazz players often let each chord ring for just a moment. Squeeze as you strum, ease off right after, and the chords start to swing.
rows.translation: Jazzmusikere lar ofte hver akkord klinge bare et øyeblikk. Trykk til når du slår an, lett straks etterpå, så begynner akkordene å svinge.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Swing guitarists comp: short chords that answer the band. The Charleston rhythm hits beat one and the swung and of two, then leaves space.
rows.translation: Swinggitarister komper: korte akkorder som svarer bandet. Charleston-rytmen treffer første slag og det svingte og etter to, og lar så rommet stå åpent.

rows.source: In G, the two, five, one is Am7, D7 and Gmaj7. Am7 is the E minor seven barre at fret 5; Gmaj7 skips string 5, with its root on string 6, fret 3.
rows.translation: I G er to, fem, en Am7, D7 og Gmaj7. Am7 er E-mollseptimbarréen på bånd 5; Gmaj7 hopper over streng 5, med grunntone på streng 6, bånd 3.

rows.translation: Late Checkout er en Timbre-original: lo-fi i C på Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 og Am7. Det er en ii–V–I, pluss sjettegradsakkorden for å starte om igjen. Komp med septimbarréene og Charleston-rytmen. Hele sangen finnes i Sanger, under Originaler.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Count up C major: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. The seventh chord on G is G7.
rows.translation: Tell opp C-dur: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. Septimakkorden på G er G7.

rows.source: No new ideas: major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, and the ii–V–I in C and G. Keep the chords short and the swing steady.
rows.translation: Ikke noe nytt: dur med stor septim, mollseptim og dominantseptim, åpne og med barré, og ii–V–I i C og G. Hold akkordene korte og svingen jevn.

rows.source: G major in two octaves at fret 2, scale degrees and chords, and the Dorian and Mixolydian modes.

rows.source: A half step is one fret, a whole step two. Every major scale climbs whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. That pattern gives major its sound.
rows.translation: Et halvtonetrinn er ett bånd, et heltonetrinn to. Alle durskalaer stiger hel, hel, halv, hel, hel, hel, halv. Mønsteret gir dur dens klang.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put finger 1 at fret 2 and give each finger its own fret, up to fret 5. From G on string 6, fret 3, the scale climbs across strings 6, 5 and 4.
rows.translation: Sett finger 1 på bånd 2 og gi hver finger sitt eget bånd, opp til bånd 5. Fra G på streng 6, bånd 3 stiger skalaen over streng 6, 5 og 4.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 6: frets 3 and 5, fingers 2 and 4. String 5: frets 2 and 3, fingers 1 and 2.
rows.translation: Streng 6: bånd 3 og 5, finger 2 og 4. Streng 5: bånd 2 og 3, finger 1 og 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 5, fret 5, then string 4: frets 2, 4 and 5. Home on G.
rows.translation: Streng 5, bånd 5, så streng 4: bånd 2, 4 og 5. Hjem på G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where do the half steps fall in a major scale?
rows.translation: Hvor ligger halvtonetrinnene i en durskala?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step is from 3 to 4. Whole, whole, whole, half: the second is from 7 to 8.
rows.translation: Hel, hel, halv: første halvtonetrinn er fra 3 til 4. Hel, hel, hel, halv: det andre er fra 7 til 8.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The same position carries on: A, B and C on string 3, D and E on string 2, F sharp and G on string 1. Your hand never moves.
rows.translation: Samme posisjon fortsetter: A, B og C på streng 3, D og E på streng 2, F kryss og G på streng 1. Hånden flytter seg aldri.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3: frets 2, 4, 5. String 2: frets 3, 5. String 1: frets 2, 3.
rows.translation: Streng 3: bånd 2, 4, 5. Streng 2: bånd 3, 5. Streng 1: bånd 2, 3.

rows.source: Finger 1 sits at fret 2, so fret 5 belongs to finger 4, your little finger.
rows.translation: Finger 1 ligger på bånd 2, så bånd 5 tilhører finger 4, lillefingeren.

rows.source: Joy to the World, arranged by Lowell Mason in 1839, opens with the G major scale straight down from the top. You know every note already.
rows.translation: Joy to the World, arrangert av Lowell Mason i 1839, åpner med G-durskalaen rett ned fra toppen. Du kan allerede hver tone.

rows.source: Number the scale from G: G is 1, A is 2, and so on up to F sharp, 7. Musicians use these numbers to talk about melodies and chords in any key.
rows.translation: Nummerer skalaen fra G: G er 1, A er 2, og så videre opp til F kryss, 7. Musikere bruker disse tallene til å snakke om melodier og akkorder i alle tonearter.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In G major, which note is 5?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.translation: Tell opp fra G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Stack every other scale note on each degree and you get the key's chords. Chords on 1, 4 and 5 are major; on 2, 3 and 6 they're minor. In G: G, C and D, then A minor, B minor and E minor.
rows.translation: Stable annenhver skalatone på hvert trinn, så får du toneartens akkorder. Akkorder på 1, 4 og 5 er dur; på 2, 3 og 6 er de moll. I G: G, C og D, så A-moll, B-moll og E-moll.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In G major, which chord is built on 6?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord bygges på 6 i G-dur?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The sixth note is E, and chords on 2, 3 and 6 are minor. Stack E, G and B: E minor.
rows.translation: Sjette tone er E, og akkorder på 2, 3 og 6 er moll. Stable E, G og B: E-moll.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play G major's notes but treat A as home, and the scale turns minor. This sound is A Dorian, a mode of G major: same position, new starting note.
rows.translation: Spill tonene fra G-dur, men behandle A som hjemme, så blir skalaen mollpreget. Denne klangen er A-dorisk, en modus av G-dur: samme posisjon, ny starttone.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Start on A, string 6, fret 5, with finger 4, and climb the same frets to A on string 3.
rows.translation: Start på A, streng 6, bånd 5, med finger 4, og stig på de samme båndene til A på streng 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which note makes A Dorian brighter than plain A minor?
rows.translation: Hvilken tone gjør A-dorisk lysere enn vanlig A-moll?

Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Plain A minor has F. Dorian keeps G major's F sharp: a bright spot in a minor scale.
rows.translation: Vanlig A-moll har F. Dorisk beholder F kryss fra G-dur: et lyspunkt i en mollskala.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Now treat D as home. G major's notes from D to D make D Mixolydian: a major scale with its seventh one fret lower. It's all over folk, rock and fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: La nå D være hjemme. Tonene i G-dur fra D til D gir D-miksolydisk: en durskala med septimen ett bånd lavere. Den finnes overalt i folkemusikk, rock og felemelodier.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From D on string 5, fret 5, up the same position to D on string 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Fra D på streng 5, bånd 5, opp i samme posisjon til D på streng 2, bånd 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: D major has C sharp. D Mixolydian has…
rows.translation: D-dur har C kryss. D-miksolydisk har…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Mixolydian lowers the seventh by one fret, so G major's C becomes its flavor note.
rows.translation: Miksolydisk senker septimen ett bånd, så C fra G-dur blir karaktertonen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Any note of the major scale can be home. From G it's major, from A Dorian, from D Mixolydian, from E plain minor. Same frets, different moods.
rows.translation: Alle tonene i durskalaen kan være hjemme. Fra G er det dur, fra A dorisk, fra D miksolydisk, fra E vanlig moll. Samme bånd, ulike stemninger.

rows.source: Move your minor pentatonic box from fret 5 down to fret 2 and treat A as home: it turns sweet and major. That's A major pentatonic: A, B, C sharp, E and F sharp.
rows.translation: Flytt mollpentatonboksen fra bånd 5 ned til bånd 2 og la A være hjemme: klangen blir søt og durpreget. Det er A-durpentatonikk: A, B, C kryss, E og F kryss.

rows.source: From A on string 6, fret 5, then frets 2 and 4 on strings 5 and 4, and A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: Fra A på streng 6, bånd 5, så bånd 2 og 4 på streng 5 og 4, og A på bånd 2 på streng 3.

rows.source: Five notes of the A major scale, its two half steps left out. The minor box at fret 5 holds A, C, D, E and G.

rows.source: This box at fret 2 is also F sharp minor pentatonic, from its F sharp. The note you treat as home decides which one you're playing.
rows.translation: Denne boksen på bånd 2 er også F kryss-mollpentatonikk, med start på F kryss. Tonen du behandler som hjemme, avgjør hvilken du spiller.

rows.source: Country players love hammer-ons inside this box: E to F sharp on string 4, A to B on string 3. Pick the first note, then hammer the second.
rows.translation: Countrymusikere elsker hammer-ons i denne boksen: E til F kryss på streng 4, A til B på streng 3. Slå an første tone, og slå så ned fingeren på den andre.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 4: pick fret 2, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 4.
rows.translation: Streng 4: slå an bånd 2, og slå så finger 3 ned på bånd 4.

rows.source: Now slide finger 3 on string 3 from fret 4 to fret 6, B up to C sharp, then glide back into the box.
rows.translation: Gli nå finger 3 på streng 3 fra bånd 4 til bånd 6, B opp til C kryss, og gli så tilbake inn i boksen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 4. Pick, then slide to fret 6 without lifting.
rows.translation: Finger 3 på streng 3, bånd 4. Slå an, og gli så til bånd 6 uten å løfte.

rows.source: A trill flutters between two notes: one pick, then hammer-on, pull-off, over and over. Keep it even before you make it fast.
rows.translation: En trille veksler raskt mellom to toner: ett anslag, så hammer-on, pull-off, om og om igjen. Hold den jevn før du gjør den rask.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3: frets 2 and 4. Pick once, then hammer and pull with finger 3.
rows.translation: Streng 3: bånd 2 og 4. Slå an én gang, og bruk så hammer-on og pull-off med finger 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Start one fret below the note you want and slide up into it as you pick. The target is what counts: land it right on the beat.
rows.translation: Start ett bånd under tonen du vil ha, og gli opp til den mens du slår an. Måltonen er det som teller: land på den akkurat på slaget.

rows.source: Over a blues in A, both boxes work. Major pentatonic at fret 2 sounds sweet; minor at fret 5 sounds tough. Good players move between them.
rows.translation: Over en blues i A fungerer begge boksene. Durpentatonikk på bånd 2 låter søtt; moll på bånd 5 låter tøft. Gode musikere veksler mellom dem.

rows.source: The major pentatonic holds C sharp, the third of A7. The minor box's C rubs against it, and that rub is the blues.
rows.translation: Durpentatonikken har C kryss, tersen i A7. C i mollboksen gnisser mot den, og den gnissingen er blues.

rows.source: Ask a tough question at fret 5, then answer it sweetly at fret 2. Shift your hand on the long note, and land both phrases on A.
rows.translation: Still et tøft spørsmål på bånd 5, og svar søtt på bånd 2. Flytt hånden på den lange tonen, og la begge frasene lande på A.

rows.source: Great solos breathe. Play a short phrase, rest about as long as it lasted, then answer. The silence makes the next notes count.
rows.translation: Gode soloer puster. Spill en kort frase, hvil omtrent like lenge som den varte, og svar så. Stillheten gir de neste tonene betydning.

rows.source: Hold each long note and rock it with a small, even push and release. Keep it narrow: the pitch should waver, never wander off.
rows.translation: Hold hver lange tone og vugg den med et lite, jevnt skyv og slipp. Hold det smalt: tonehøyden skal bølge, aldri drive av gårde.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Slow Motion Strobe is a Timbre Original: synth-pop in A on F sharp minor, D, A and E. Your box at fret 2 fits the whole loop: A major pentatonic, which is F sharp minor pentatonic too. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Slow Motion Strobe er en Timbre-original: synthpop i A på F kryss-moll, D, A og E. Boksen på bånd 2 passer over hele sløyfen: A-durpentatonikk, som også er F kryss-mollpentatonikk. Hele sangen finnes i Sanger, under Originaler.

rows.source: Listen to the first chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Lytt til første akkord. Dur eller moll?

rows.source: Most songs are built from a few sections: verses that tell the story, a chorus that repeats the hook, and sometimes a bridge for contrast. Knowing the plan keeps you from getting lost.
rows.translation: De fleste sanger bygges av noen få deler: vers som forteller historien, et refreng som gjentar motivet, og av og til en bro som kontrast. Når du kjenner planen, går du deg ikke vill.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The chorus returns with the same words and tune. It's the part people remember and sing along to.
rows.translation: Refrenget kommer tilbake med samme tekst og melodi. Det er delen folk husker og synger med på.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Many older songs use AABA: a tune, the same tune again, a contrasting bridge, then the tune once more. Each section often runs eight bars; here they run four.
rows.translation: Mange eldre sanger bruker AABA: en melodi, samme melodi igjen, en kontrasterende bro, så melodien én gang til. Hver del varer ofte åtte takter; her varer de fire.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Hvilken del er broen i AABA-form?

rows.source: The easiest intro is the song's last line, played before the first verse. It sets the key, the tempo and the mood, and the singer knows exactly where to come in.
rows.translation: Den enkleste introen er sangens siste linje, spilt før første vers. Den angir toneart, tempo og stemning, og sangeren vet akkurat hvor han eller hun skal komme inn.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Hvorfor starte med sangens siste linje?

rows.source: To end, repeat the last line, often twice more, and let the final chord ring. A tag tells everyone the song is closing.
rows.translation: For å avslutte gjentar du siste linje, ofte to ganger til, og lar siste akkord klinge. En slik avslutning forteller alle at sangen er på vei mot slutten.

rows.source: Arrangers lift a chorus by changing what the guitar does. Fingerpick the verse softly, then strum the chorus, and the same chords suddenly sound bigger.
rows.translation: Arrangører løfter refrenget ved å endre hva gitaren gjør. Bruk mykt fingerspill i verset, og slå så an refrenget, så låter de samme akkordene plutselig større.

rows.source: Jukebox Moon is a Timbre Original: a fifties slow dance in AABA form, a verse, the verse again, a bridge on F, then the verse once more. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Jukebox Moon er en Timbre-original: en rolig femtitallsdans i AABA-form, et vers, verset igjen, en bro på F, så verset én gang til. Slå an hvert slag, med et raskt, svingt oppslag inn i hver ny takt. Hele sangen finnes i Sanger, under Originaler.

rows.source: D7: a barre and one finger
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 2, and put finger 2 on string 1, fret 3.
rows.translation: Legg finger 1 over streng 4, 3 og 2 på bånd 2, og sett finger 2 på streng 1, bånd 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In G, the chords G, C and D7 do most of the work, with E minor for a darker color. D7 pulls back to G the way G7 pulls to C.
rows.translation: I G gjør akkordene G, C og D7 det meste, med E-moll for en mørkere farge. D7 trekker tilbake til G slik G7 trekker til C.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: B minor and the key of D
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 2, then reach finger 3 to string 4, fret 4.
rows.translation: Legg finger 1 over streng 3, 2 og 1 på bånd 2, og strekk så finger 3 til streng 4, bånd 4.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D and B minor both press fret 2 on which strings?
rows.translation: På hvilke strenger trykker både D og B-moll ned bånd 2?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Both chords hold fret 2 on strings 3 and 2. Only the outer strings change.
rows.translation: Begge akkorder holder bånd 2 på streng 3 og 2. Bare de ytterste strengene endres.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: In D, the chords D, G and A7 carry the song, and B minor adds a sad one. A7 is a single finger: string 3, fret 1.
rows.translation: I D bærer akkordene D, G og A7 sangen, og B-moll gir en trist farge. A7 er én finger: streng 3, bånd 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A song's chords are steps of its key: I, IV and V. Change key and the numbers stay. In C that's C, F and G7; in G, it's G, C and D7; in F, F, B flat and C7.
rows.translation: Akkordene i en sang er trinn i tonearten: I, IV og V. Bytt toneart, så blir tallene. I C er det C, F og G7; i G er det G, C og D7; i F er det F, B med b og C7.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of F, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord er IV i F?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from F: F, G, A, B flat. The fourth note is B flat.
rows.translation: Tell opp fra F: F, G, A, B med b. Fjerde tone er B med b.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: If a song sits too high or too low to sing, move it to another key. Same numbers, same song, just a better fit for the voice.
rows.translation: Hvis en sang ligger for høyt eller lavt å synge, flytt den til en annen toneart. Samme tall, samme sang, bare bedre tilpasset stemmen.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of D, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord er V i D?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from D: D, E, F sharp, G, A. A is the fifth note, so A7 is the V chord.
rows.translation: Tell opp fra D: D, E, F kryss, G, A. A er femte tone, så A7 er V-akkorden.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 3 on string 2, fret 3, and finger 1 on string 1, fret 1. String 4 rings open.
rows.translation: Finger 2 på streng 3, bånd 2, finger 3 på streng 2, bånd 3 og finger 1 på streng 1, bånd 1. Streng 4 klinger åpen.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: D minor's family is D minor, G minor and A7. A7 pulls home to D minor, the way E7 pulls to A minor.
rows.translation: Familien til D-moll er D-moll, G-moll og A7. A7 trekker hjem til D-moll slik E7 trekker til A-moll.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, and the keys of C, G, F and D. Clean shapes first, then a steady strum.
rows.translation: Ikke noe nytt: B med b, D7, B-moll og G-moll, og toneartene C, G, F og D. Rene grep først, så jevne anslag.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of G, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord er V i G?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 “Strum styles” · title

rows.source: The chunk, the island strum with a backbeat, swing and the ragtime chords, accents in 3-3-2, and the waltz.
rows.translation: Dempede klikkanslag, øy-anslag med bakslag, swing og ragtimeakkorder, betoning i 3-3-2 og vals.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 “Strum styles” · unit summary
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A chunk is a strum that stops dead. Strum down and let the side of your palm land on the strings at the same moment: a short, dry click, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Et klikkanslag stopper helt opp. Slå ned og la håndkanten lande på strengene i samme øyeblikk: et kort, tørt klikk, som en skarptromme.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum down on 1, chunk on 2, down-up on 3, chunk on 4. The chunks fall where a drummer hits the snare.
rows.translation: Slå ned på 1, klikk på 2, ned-opp på 3, klikk på 4. Klikkene faller der en trommeslager treffer skarptrommen.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Two and four are the backbeat, where the snare drum plays. A chunk there gives the strum a drummer's punch.
rows.translation: To og fire er bakslagene, der skarptrommen spiller. Et klikkanslag der gir anslaget trommetrøkk.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · title

rows.source: Swap one down for a chunk
rows.translation: Bytt ett nedslag mot et klikk
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Take the island strum, D, DU, UDU, and turn the down on 2 into a chunk. The rhythm stays the same; the groove gets a backbeat.
rows.translation: Ta øy-anslaget, D, DU, UDU, og gjør nedslaget på 2 til et klikk. Rytmen er den samme; grooven får et bakslag.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In this strum, which stroke becomes the chunk?
rows.translation: Hvilket anslag blir klikket i dette mønsteret?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 1 rings out, beat 2 clicks. Everything else stays where the island strum had it.
rows.translation: Slag 1 klinger, slag 2 klikker. Alt annet blir der øy-anslaget hadde det.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · title

rows.source: Swing splits each beat unevenly: a long down, then a short up. Say hum-pty, dum-pty as you strum. It's the bounce of old ukulele tunes.
rows.translation: Swing deler hvert slag ujevnt: et langt nedslag, så et kort oppslag. Si hum-pty, dum-pty mens du slår an. Det er spretten i gamle ukulelemelodier.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: C, A7, D7, G7, then home to C. Each seventh chord pulls to the next, a little chain of tension. It powered countless songs a century ago.
rows.translation: C, A7, D7, G7, så hjem til C. Hver septimakkord trekker mot den neste, en liten kjede av spenning. Den drev utallige sanger for hundre år siden.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord does D7 pull toward here?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord trekker D7 mot her?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D7 leads to G, and G7 leads home to C. Each chord sets up the next.
rows.translation: D7 leder til G, og G7 leder hjem til C. Hver akkord forbereder den neste.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum steady down-up eighths, but hit three of them harder: 1, the and of 2, and 4. The accents fall 3, 3 and 2 eighths apart.
rows.translation: Slå jevne ned-opp-åttedeler, men treff tre av dem hardere: 1, og etter 2, og 4. Mellom betoningene er det 3, 3 og 2 åttedeler.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2 across the bar's eight eighths. Each 1 is an accent.
rows.translation: Tell 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2 over taktens åtte åttedeler. Hver 1 er en betoning.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: George Formby's split stroke on the banjo ukulele puts its big strums in the same three places, with single strings in between. Master the accents first.
rows.translation: George Formbys delte anslag på banjoukulele legger de store anslagene på de samme tre stedene, med enkeltstrenger imellom. Lær betoningene først.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In three, strum down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: D, DU, DU. Lean on 1 so the sway is clear.
rows.translation: I tretakt slår du ned på 1, så ned-opp på 2 og på 3: D, DU, DU. Legg vekt på 1 så vuggingen blir tydelig.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many strums fill this bar of three?
rows.translation: Hvor mange anslag fyller denne tretakten?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: one plus two plus two.
rows.translation: Ned på 1, så ned-opp på 2 og på 3: én pluss to pluss to.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: chunks, the island strum with a chunk, swing, the 3-3-2 accents and the waltz. Keep the hand moving and let the accents speak.
rows.translation: Ikke noe nytt: klikkanslag, øy-anslag med klikk, swing, 3-3-2-betoning og vals. Hold hånden i bevegelse og la betoningene snakke.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In a swing strum, each beat splits into…
rows.translation: I et swinganslag deles hvert slag i…
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 9 “Fingerpicking and chord melody” · title

rows.source: One finger per string, rolling patterns, the alternating thumb, and a tune picked from inside its chords.
rows.translation: Én finger per streng, rullende mønstre, vekslende tommel og en melodi plukket frem inne i akkordene.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 “Fingerpicking and chord melody” · unit summary
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rest your thumb on string 4, index on string 3, middle on string 2 and ring finger on string 1. Each one plucks only its own string.
rows.translation: La tommelen hvile på streng 4, pekefingeren på streng 3, langfingeren på streng 2 og ringfingeren på streng 1. Hver knipser bare sin egen streng.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle, ring: strings 4, 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Tommel, pekefinger, langfinger, ringfinger: streng 4, 3, 2 og 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Thumb on 4, index on 3, middle on 2, ring on 1: one finger per string.
rows.translation: Tommel på 4, pekefinger på 3, langfinger på 2, ringfinger på 1: én finger per streng.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 4 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Because string 4 is a high G, the pattern zigzags: high, low, then climbing. That sparkle is the sound of fingerpicked ukulele.
rows.translation: Fordi streng 4 er en høy G, går mønsteret i sikksakk: høyt, lavt, så stigende. Den glitrende klangen er lyden av ukulele med fingerspill.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: A minor, F, C, G7, in eighths
rows.translation: A-moll, F, C, G7 i åttedeler
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 7 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pluck strings 4, 3, 2 and 1, then come back on 2 and 3: thumb, index, middle, ring, middle, index. Six notes fill a bar of three.
rows.translation: Knips streng 4, 3, 2 og 1, og gå tilbake på 2 og 3: tommel, pekefinger, langfinger, ringfinger, langfinger, pekefinger. Seks toner fyller en tretakt.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: After the ring finger plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
rows.translation: Hvilken finger kommer etter at ringfingeren knipser streng 1?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The roll turns around at the top: ring on string 1, then middle on 2 and index on 3.
rows.translation: Mønsteret snur på toppen: ringfinger på streng 1, så langfinger på 2 og pekefinger på 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Land the new chord as the thumb starts the next bar. The fingers keep rolling; only the shape under them changes.
rows.translation: Land den nye akkorden idet tommelen starter neste takt. Fingrene fortsetter å rulle; bare grepet under dem endres.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C, A minor, D minor, G7
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 7 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now the thumb rocks between strings 3 and 4 on the beats while your fingers pluck strings 2 and 1 in between. It's the ukulele's version of Travis picking.
rows.translation: Nå veksler tommelen mellom streng 3 og 4 på slagene, mens fingrene knipser streng 2 og 1 imellom. Det er ukulelens versjon av Travis-plukking.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: In this pattern, what does the thumb do?
rows.translation: Hva gjør tommelen i dette mønsteret?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The thumb keeps the pulse, a note on every beat, while the fingers fill the gaps.
rows.translation: Tommelen holder pulsen, én tone på hvert slag, mens fingrene fyller mellomrommene.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 5 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 6 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · title

rows.source: Hold the chord, pick the tune
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In chord melody, your fretting hand holds the chord and you pick the tune from inside it. Hold F, and C, F and A are already under your fingers.
rows.translation: I akkordmelodi holder gripehånden akkorden mens du plukker melodien ut av den. Hold F, så ligger C, F og A allerede under fingrene.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Hold F: open string 3, string 2 at fret 1, open string 1. That's how Amazing Grace begins.
rows.translation: Hold F: åpen streng 3, streng 2 på bånd 1, åpen streng 1. Slik starter Amazing Grace.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: When the tune leaves the chord, reach with a free finger. Over F, finger 3 takes G on string 2, fret 3, then lifts as the tune comes back.
rows.translation: Når melodien forlater akkorden, strekk en ledig finger. Over F tar finger 3 G på streng 2, bånd 3, og løftes når melodien vender tilbake.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Over B flat, where is the tune's D?
rows.translation: Hvor er melodiens D over B med b?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B flat's finger 2 already holds D on string 3, fret 2. The tune walks right through the chord.
rows.translation: Finger 2 i B med b holder allerede D på streng 3, bånd 2. Melodien går rett gjennom akkorden.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rolled chords between the verses and the melody inside the chords. The tune is the hymn New Britain, printed in 1829, with John Newton's words.
rows.translation: Rullende akkorder mellom versene og melodien inne i akkordene. Melodien er salmen New Britain, trykt i 1829, med tekst av John Newton.

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle, ring play which strings?

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 “Campfire to stage” · unit summary

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, first printed in 1918, is made for singing together. On ukulele it sits in G, with G, C and D7, and a gospel A sharp on string 1, fret 1.
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside, først trykt i 1918, er laget for allsang. På ukulele ligger den i G, med G, C og D7, og en gospelpreget A kryss på streng 1, bånd 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-1 “Down by the Riverside” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sharp, B, then A and G.
rows.translation: Down by the riverside: B, B, A kryss, B, så A og G.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-1 “Down by the Riverside” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Cecil Sharp printed this English ballad in 1906. In F it uses F, B flat, C and C7, G minor and D minor, often two to a bar. Pick the chords between verses and let them ring.
rows.translation: Cecil Sharp trykte denne engelske balladen i 1906. I F bruker den F, B med b, C og C7, G-moll og D-moll, ofte to per takt. Plukk akkordene mellom versene og la dem klinge.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The water is wide: open string 3, F at fret 1 twice, G at fret 3, then open A.
rows.translation: The water is wide: åpen streng 3, F på bånd 1 to ganger, G på bånd 3, så åpen A.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Many bars here change halfway. Count the verse in two-beat halves, one chord each, and change on every other click.
rows.translation: Mange takter her skifter halvveis. Tell verset i halvdeler på to slag, én akkord hver, og bytt på annethvert klikk.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Before the first strum, count out loud at the song's tempo: one, two, three, four. Everyone starts together, at the speed you set.
rows.translation: Før første anslag teller du høyt i sangens tempo: en, to, tre, fire. Alle starter sammen, i farten du setter.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Miss a chord? Keep strumming and catch the next one. A singing room follows the beat, not every note.
rows.translation: Bommer du på en akkord? Fortsett å slå an og treff den neste. Et rom som synger, følger takten, ikke hver tone.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: You fumble a change mid-song. What now?
rows.translation: Du roter til et skift midt i sangen. Hva nå?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Keep strumming and catch the next chord
rows.translation: Fortsett anslagene og treff neste akkord
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Senk tempoet til det er rettet
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The beat carries everyone. Drop a chord if you must, never the rhythm.
rows.translation: Takten bærer alle. Dropp en akkord om du må, aldri rytmen.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before the last line, nod or call out last time. Slow the final line a touch and let the last chord ring.
rows.translation: Før siste linje nikker du eller sier “siste gang”. Senk tempoet litt i siste linje og la siste akkord klinge.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Molly Malone was printed in 1876. It's a waltz: lean on beat 1 and let the tune sway. In F it uses F, G minor, C7, D minor and G7.
rows.translation: Molly Malone ble trykt i 1876. Det er en vals: legg vekt på slag 1 og la melodien vugge. I F bruker den F, G-moll, C7, D-moll og G7.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In Dublin's fair city: open string 3, F at fret 1 four times, open A, back to F.
rows.translation: In Dublin's fair city: åpen streng 3, F på bånd 1 fire ganger, åpen A, tilbake til F.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which chord pulls hardest back to F?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord trekker sterkest tilbake til F?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C7 is the V chord in F. Its seventh leans straight back home.
rows.translation: C7 er V-akkorden i F. Septimen trekker rett hjem.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: This rowing song is in six-eight: six quick counts to a bar, felt as two big sways. Count 1 2 3, 4 5 6, and lean on 1 and 4.
rows.translation: Denne rosangen går i seks åttendedeler: seks raske tellinger per takt, følt som to store vugginger. Tell 1 2 3, 4 5 6, og legg vekt på 1 og 4.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In six-eight, where do the big beats fall?
rows.translation: Hvor faller de store slagene i seks åttendedeler?

rows.source: Six eighths group in two threes: 1 2 3, 4 5 6. The first of each three carries the sway.
rows.translation: Seks åttedeler samles i to grupper på tre: 1 2 3, 4 5 6. Den første i hver gruppe bærer vuggingen.

rows.translation: Ikke noe nytt: fire sanger, telt opp, holdt i gang og avsluttet rent. Spill dem etter hverandre som en kort konsert.

rows.source: Meet E A D G, pluck with two fingers, play your first notes and a song.
rows.translation: Bli kjent med E A D G, knips med to fingre, spill dine første toner og en sang.

Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 4.
rows.translation: Den tykkeste strengen har den dypeste tonen. Den er nærmest ansiktet når du spiller. Vi kaller den streng 4.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Strings count from the thinnest (1) to the thickest (4).
rows.translation: Strengene telles fra den tynneste (1) til den tykkeste (4).
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: From thick to thin: E, A, D, G. They match the four lowest guitar strings, an octave down. Try: Every Amp Drives Grooves.
rows.translation: Fra tykk til tynn: E, A, D, G. De tilsvarer de fire dypeste gitarstrengene, én oktav lavere. Prøv huskeregelen: En Ape Danser Gjerne.

rows.source: Pluck with the pads of your index and middle fingers, taking turns. Rest your thumb on the pickup or on string 4.
rows.translation: Knips vekselvis med putene på peke- og langfingeren. La tommelen hvile på pickupen eller på streng 4.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-3 “Plucking with two fingers” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-3 “Plucking with two fingers” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pluck across the string, not up and away. Your finger comes to rest on the next thicker string. This rest stroke sounds full and strong.
rows.translation: Knips på tvers av strengen, ikke opp og bort. Fingeren lander på neste tykkere streng. Dette støtteanslaget låter fyldig og sterkt.

rows.source: In the air above the strings

rows.translation: Å trekke gjennom til neste streng holder bevegelsen liten og tonen sterk.

rows.source: Open strings, two-finger plucking and your first fretted notes. Keep your fingers taking turns and let each note ring.
rows.translation: Åpne strenger, knipsing med to fingre og dine første grepne toner. La fingrene veksle og hver tone klinge.

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: B at fret 2 on string 3, open A, and G at fret 3 on string 4. Second finger for B, third for G.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb trenger tre toner: B på bånd 2 på streng 3, åpen A og G på bånd 3 på streng 4. Andre finger til B, tredje til G.

rows.source: String 3, fret 2, second finger. That's B.
rows.translation: Streng 3, bånd 2, andre finger. Det er B.

rows.source: B A G A B B B: string 3, then G on string 4.
rows.translation: B A G A B B B: streng 3, så G på streng 4.

rows.source: Play the root of each chord and lock in with the beat.
rows.translation: Spill grunntonen i hver akkord og treff takten presist.

rows.translation: Hver akkord er bygd på én tone, grunntonen. Grunntonen i en A-akkord er A. Bassister spiller grunntoner så bandet vet hvor hjemme er.

rows.source: What is the root of a D chord?
rows.translation: Hva er grunntonen i en D-akkord?

rows.source: Root or not? Listen to the lowest note.
rows.translation: Grunntone eller ikke? Lytt til dypeste tone.

rows.source: Roots of A, D and E

rows.translation: En pause er et slag med stillhet. Stopp strengen ved å berøre den lett med en ledig finger, så pausen blir like ren som tonen.

rows.source: Touch it lightly with a free finger
rows.translation: Berører den lett med en ledig finger

rows.source: Muting is half of bass playing. Rest a finger lightly on the string to silence it.
